title: DTIC ADA039156: Feasibility Study of 5.56 MM Folded Ammunition/Weapon System
preview: Folded Ammunition is a unique concept in ammunition design that relocates the propellant charge from the conventional position behind and coaxial with the projectile to one beside the projectile. title: DTIC AD1019910: Patents for Soldiers
preview: Army leaders and doctrine describe innovation as an important pillar of today's and tomorrow's Army. At the pinnacle of innovation is the legally recognized protection of an innovative idea; that is, a patent. A Soldier's pursuit of patents provides the Army with tangible and intangible benefits.
